items.description: Determine whether the Watcher orchestrator prompt, Watcher graph, or Application Client consumer-integration gate needs correction so future Watcher runtime launch has explicit, acyclic ordering.
items.terminalPath: Exactly one of prompt correction, graph dependency, or gate reshape.

evidence.details: The prompt says watcher-runtime-core remains planned until Application Client client-conformance and the consumer-integration gate permit it.
watcher-runtime-core depends on dumb-watcher-contract-gate and externally on Application Client client-conformance; it does not name consumer-integration-gate.

The roadmap keeps both consumer runtimes blocked through conformance and the consumer-integration gate, and keeps watcher-runtime-core planned until client-conformance proves the required cross-backend behavior.
